_comment: The start of the ONLY at-risk source with no failure event. This order is created and then nothing happens -- no payment.captured, no payment.failed, no webhook of any kind, because closing a browser tab is not something Razorpay can observe. This payload opens NO case. It puts the order on a watch list, and app/workers/sweeper.py opens a case ABANDON_MINUTES later if the payment never arrived. Note amount_paid 0 and status created: that is the whole signal.
